CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  HELD VIA TELECONFERENCE
  Wednesday, May 12, 2021

1.  Vice-Chairperson Phil May called the regular meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:30 p.m. He stated that all comments should be sent to
  planning@cityoflaverne.org.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Lorge led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Jeff Allred, Phil May, Thomas
  Allison, and Jason Lorge. Not present: Jason Simison. Advisory personnel
  present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City Attorney Bob
  Kress, Public Works Director Shawn Igoe, Principal Planner Candice Bowcock,
  Assistant Planner Gabriel Rivera and Secretary Natalie Hiatt.

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  No public comments were received.

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  February 24, 2021; March 10, 2021; March 17, 2021; and April 14, 2021

  It was moved by Commissioner May and seconded by Commissioner Allison to
  approve the minutes. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

6.  CASE NO. 28-21VAR – A REQUEST TO CONSTRUCT A COVERED
  PORCH WITHIN THE FRONT YARD SETBACK AT 2318 5TH STREET.
  THE PROPOSAL INCLUDES A PRECISE PLAN REVIEW FOR THE
  PORCH AND A VARIANCE FOR AN ENCROACHMENT INTO THE
  REQUIRED FRONT SETBACKS.

  RESOLUTION NO. 1272

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
 Planning Commission Minutes
May 12, 2021
  GRANTING A VARIANCE TO PERMIT A COVERED PORCH IN THE
  FRONT YARD SETBACK OF THE HOME LOCATED AT 2318 5TH
  STREET (CASE NO. 23-21VAR), AND AFFIRMING THAT THIS
  APPLICATION IS CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT FROM THE
  CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT.

  Assistant Planner Gabriel Rivera presented his report.

  Commissioner May opened the public hearing.

  The applicants Daniel and Kellee Flanders were present at the meeting. They
  thanked the Planning Commission for reviewing their project.

  Commissioner May closed the public hearing.

  It was moved by Commissioner Allison and seconded by Commissioner Lorge to
  approve Case No. 28-21VAR. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

OTHER MATTERS/INFORMATION

7.  CASE NO. 147-18IUP – EXTENSION REQUEST FOR AN INTERIM USE
  PERMIT TO ALLOW THE OPERATION OF A CONSTRUCTION
  INDUSTRY BUSINESS WITH RELATED USES AT 2425 FIRST STREET.

  Principal Planner Candice Bowcock presented her report.

  Commissioner May opened the public hearing.

  Applicant Eric Davis was present at the meeting. Mr. Davis expressed his
  appreciation for an extension.

  Commissioner May closed the public hearing.

  It was moved by Commissioner Lorge and seconded by Commissioner Allison to
  approve a one year extension to Case No. 147-18IUP. Motion carried by a 4-0
  vote.

8.  CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM (CIP) – THE CITY OF LA
  VERNE CONTINUES TO PREPARE AND ADOPT A CAPITAL
  IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM AS A PART OF THE ANNUAL BUDGET
  AND TO MORE RESPONSIBLY PLAN FOR LONG RANGE CAPITAL
  IMPROVEMENTS. A COMPREHENSIVE CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT
  PROGRAM SUCH AS THIS REQUIRES REVIEW BY THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION FOR CONSISTENCY WITH THE ADOPTED GENERAL
  PLAN.

  2
 Planning Commission Minutes
May 12, 2021
  Mr. Scherer introduced new Public Works Director Shawn Igoe.
  Principal Planner Candice Bowcock presented her report.

  It was by moved Commissioner Allred and seconded by Commissioner Lorge to
  approve Resolution 1273. The motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

  Mr. Igoe stated that over the next five years they are seeking $14 million dollars
  from grants to help fund the projects.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:55 p.m. The next regular meeting of the Planning
  Commission will be held June 9, 2021 at 6:30 p.m.

  ____________________________________________
  Vice-Chairperson, Planning Commission
